MACHINE LEARNING FUNDAMENTALS

Chapter 1: Supervised Learning
Supervised learning involves training a model on labeled data.
Key algorithms: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, SVM, Neural Networks.

Chapter 2: Unsupervised Learning
Unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data.
Key algorithms: K-Means Clustering, DBSCAN, PCA, Autoencoders.

Chapter 3: Model Evaluation
Metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 Score, AUC-ROC.
Techniques: Cross-validation, Train/Test split, Confusion Matrix.
